Sub: Audio Recording of Q4 FY 2025-26 Earnings Call 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
This is in furtherance to our letter dated 30th April 2026 intimating about the Earnings call scheduled 
on 06th May 2026. 
In this regard, kindly note that pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with clause 15 of Para A of 
Part A of Schedule lII of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, the audio recording of the earnings call held on 06th May 2026 is uploaded on the Company's 
website at https:/hr.vw.exideindustries.com/investors/earnings-call.aspx. 
We further confirm that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information has been shared/discussed during the 
call. 
We request you to kindly take the same on record. 
Thanking you. 
Yours faithfully,
